context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Replace the wildcard `app.use(cors())` with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins, for example: `const allowedOrigins = (process.env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS || 'https://app.example.com').split(','); app.use(cors({ origin: (origin, cb) => { if (!origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) return cb(null, true); return cb(new Error('Origin not allowed by CORS')); }, credentials: true, methods: ['GET','POST','PUT','DELETE'], allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type','Authorization'] }));`. Only list https:// origins. If credentials are allowed, never use `origin: '*'` or reflect the request origin. Also serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only: put `app.set('trust proxy', 1)` behind a TLS-terminating proxy, redirect HTTP to HTTPS, and set HSTS with `helmet.hsts({ maxAge: 31536000, includeSubDomains: true })`. Set session cookies with `cookie: { secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'strict' }` (use 'lax' if cross-site navigation needs it). These controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires.
